watch.en: Keep yolk and any fat out of the whites and beat them to the stage the recipe names (soft or stiff peaks).
watch.de: Eigelb und jedes Fett von den Eiweißen fernhalten und sie bis zu der Stufe schlagen, die das Rezept nennt (weiche oder steife Spitzen).

why.en: Beating makes the proteins form a film around air bubbles; fat of any kind limits the foam.
why.de: Beim Schlagen bilden die Eiweiße einen Film um Luftbläschen; jedes Fett begrenzt den Schaum.

sources.title: Food Preparation Lab Manual (Beirman and Gilbert)
sources.place: chapter 9.1 Introduction to Egg White Foams, section Egg White Foams
sources.sentence: Egg whites foam because proteins denature upon beating and form a film around air bubbles.

sources.title: Food Preparation Lab Manual (Beirman and Gilbert)
sources.place: chapter 9.1 Introduction to Egg White Foams, section Egg White Foams
sources.sentence: Fat of any kind (from yolk or other sources) inhibits or limits foam formation.

sources.sentence: Then the egg whites are beaten to the stage listed in the recipe.
